analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($279.05) vs SMA5 ($276.31)/SMA20 ($285.64)/SMA50 ($319.64): short-term attempt to rise, below mid-term, below long-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($332.99)/SMA200 ($336.29): maintaining strong mid-to-long-term downtrend.
· 52-week position (10.3%) + current price range near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (32.9→39.6): attempting to exit oversold territory, weak upward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.6801→0.6544): holding steady without improvement, no bearish reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower $262.40, Middle $285.64): approaching lower band, band width narrowed to 16.27%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($276.92): based on moving average (SMA5) and Fibonacci retracement 0.786 level.
· Swing resistance ($291.59): based on pivot (PP) and Bollinger Band middle line, potential for short-term rebound upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low formed, sideways): absence of trend reversal signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.80x): subdued confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI attempting to exit oversold but weak trend formation, consider buying upon break above $291.59.
